name: com.plcgateway/plcgateway
title: PLCGateway
description: Ask your plant: live PLC data, alarms, history, OEE and reports from your on-premises PLCGateway.

environmentVariables.name: PLCGATEWAY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Address of your PLCGateway SCADA or Connect, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8080

environmentVariables.name: PLCGATEWAY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token (PLCGateway → Settings → API token), or the MCP configuration token for device/tag setup
